reviewer: Kimi independent actual visual comparison of the exact native source, enlarged source page 06 and targeted source-note crops, complete unchanged native RGBA raw, targeted native-resolution returned-note crop, full white/cyan/alpha sheet and unchanged naiwa mascot reference

remaining_reasons: The source-note crop shows only two compact faint upper gray-mark rows and no lower-left third mark. The returned native pixels add a separate lower-left gray dash below the two main rows, as well as expanding the upper marks into denser multi-blob groups. Remove the invented third mark and restore only the source-scale two-row upper footprint, leaving the lower paper largely blank.
entries.positive_observation: The high bald crown, short gray-brown side hair and dark eyebrows remain, and the thin dark spectacles are rectangular rather than replaced with round glasses. The face has one closed mouth, a smooth chin and no added moustache or beard. The slight viewer-left three-quarter head/gaze and upper-chest crop remain. The dark olive uniform retains two red collar patches with gold details, one pale ribbon and one small silver-toned neck pendant partly beside the note. The rounded chin meets a short broad fitted collar without a long stalk or clipping. The complete tilted dark frame, opaque gray-olive photographic backing, warm-cream note and small right-edge tab remain. Full white/cyan comparisons show no visible interior holes, lost backing or working-matte outer ring; the added note content is the separate rejection reason above.
entries.visible_limitations: Precise spectacle-rim geometry, fine upper-lip pixels and tiny pendant/ribbon details are not fully readable at 65x67, and note glyphs are not readable text. These uncertainties are not rejection reasons; the source clearly lacks the returned separate lower-left third dash.
